title: 受験・合格祈願のイラスト
subject_en: Exam-season and good-luck items, each a separate object, kawaii soft style, friendly and encouraging, no text Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 鉛筆、絵馬、お守り、桜。受験生をはげますカードやお知らせに使える12点。

a study desk with a lamp, books and a mug
a stack of three blank-cover workbooks
a round alarm clock with bells
